name: iphone-home-screen
description: Organize an iPhone home screen over USB or Wi-Fi: move apps, create and tidy folders, find offloaded apps, preview changes, back up and restore.

interface.shortDescription: Rearrange your iPhone home screen by asking
interface.longDescription: Move apps, create and tidy folders, and find offloaded apps on an iPhone connected to this Mac over USB or Wi-Fi. Every change is shown as a plan first, backed up before it is written, and verified afterwards. macOS 13 or later; includes a prebuilt iconctl binary.
defaultPrompt: Show me what's on my iPhone home screen
